agenda.title: 📅 Calendar view
agenda.text: This button shows all the month's birthdays, name days and events at a glance.

addDate.title: 🎂 Your first date
addDate.text: Tap ＋ to add your first birthday. Off you go!

addEvent.title: 🎉 Your first event
addEvent.text: Tap ＋ to plan a party: put the date and place to a vote, invite your friends, suggest gifts and start a money pool.

friends.title: 👥 Your friends
friends.text: It all starts here: add your friends to see their birthdays automatically, chat with them and invite them to your events.

notifs.title: 🔔 Notifications
notifs.text: Choose what you want to receive: push notifications on this phone (birthdays, messages, events…) and email reminders.

wishlist.title: 🎀 Your wishlist
wishlist.text: List the gifts you would like: your friends check it so they never get it wrong, and you can check theirs!

e2e.title: 🔐 Encryption & security
e2e.text: Your messages are end-to-end encrypted. This section lets you manage your encryption keys.
